name: knowledge-work
description: Anthropic's knowledge-work plugins (Apache-2.0), project-local: productivity + engineering + design by default; add others with --plugin.

sources.name: knowledge-work-plugins
sources.note: Marketplace with 20+ plugins; MCP connectors inside them are imported disabled until you enable them.

notes: Enable a plugin's MCP connectors by setting "enabled": true in .ai-sandbox/mcp/servers.json, then `aisb sync`.
Other plugins: aisb apply github:anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins --plugin sales,legal,finance
